name: The Mending
description: The event in which Jeska sacrificed herself to close the time rifts.

description_citations.text: "Venser". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi recalls wandering Dominaria since the Mending, unsettled by his guilt over Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: He had been wandering for the past several years, since the Mending

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Aylith and Nazir recite the Awakening Ritual, causing the Mending of the Clan Tree and ending the fighting.
timeline.quote: a new sapling Clan Tree took root, restoring balance to the plane

citation.text: "Aylith", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska closes the Otarian rift and dies, causing the Mending.
timeline.quote: Jeska finally closed the most massive rift over Otaria

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Planeswalkers lose their immortality and godlike powers.
timeline.quote: Planeswalkers lost their immortality and godlike powers and much of their additional magic power.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska shatters the image of Karona and closes all rifts in one discharge, allowing the Great Mending to begin.
timeline.quote: In one huge discharge of her power, she closed them all, allowing the Great Mending to begin.

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Mending Llanowar is among the first regions to be rejuvenated.
timeline.quote: Llanowar was one of the first Dominarian regions that were rejuvenated after the Mending .

citation.text: "Llanowar", section "Post-Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Mending, the Meditation Plane becomes a pocket plane; Sarkhan visits and is debriefed by Bolas.
timeline.quote: the Meditation Plane became a pocket plane of its own, separate from Dominaria

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "Post-Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dominaria stops being the Nexus of the Multiverse after the Mending.
timeline.quote: stopped being the Nexus of the Multiverse after the Mending

citation.text: "Multiverse", section "Nexus of the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska sacrifices her life and spark to mend all temporal rifts in the Multiverse, an event that changes the nature of Planeswalker sparks.
timeline.quote: Jeska sacrificed her life and her spark to mend all temporal rifts in the Multiverse

citation.text: "Planeswalker (lore)", section "Current Planeswalkers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Mending the ghost-world anomaly dissolves and trapped spirits can pass on.
timeline.quote: the Ravnican ghost-world anomaly was dissolved, and the trapped spirits were able to pass on to the aether

citation.text: "Ravnica", section "Ravnica and the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With the Otarian rift closed by Jeska, the Great Mending begins.
timeline.quote: With the last major rift sealed, the Great Mending began.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Otarian rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aylith heals Nazir's madness; they recite the ritual and the Clan Tree is mended.
timeline.quote: A small sapling Clan Tree arises and the plane's balance is restored.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Mending, mana reinvigorates Urborg's necromancers and the Acolytes unravel.
timeline.quote: the Windgrace Acolytes began to unravel

citation.text: "Urborg", section "Post-Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska casts Venser and Radha back and sacrifices herself, and the Mending takes place.
timeline.quote: with that final sacrifice, the Mending took place

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
